lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity, roughly circular local maxima are distributed in a grid-like pattern posterior to the branchial region, specifically concentrated between the first and second carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, creating distinctive nodes of high pixel intensity across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible; the superior ridge displays a significant vertical gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense aggregation of small commensal fish is localized around the pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral margin of the trunk.
